description: Esparex Monorepo Canonical Ownership Registry — Single Source of Truth for Domain, Package, and Module Ownership Boundaries

packages/contracts.name: Monorepo SSOT API Contracts & DTOs
packages/contracts.boundary: Provides Zod schemas, API DTOs, request/response payload contracts across all HTTP and RPC boundaries.

packages/design-tokens.name: Monorepo Design Tokens Engine
packages/design-tokens.boundary: Provides semantic and foundational design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, elevation) and CSS generation scripts.

packages/ui.name: Monorepo Shared UI Design System
packages/ui.boundary: Provides shared, domain-agnostic presentation: design tokens (Z_INDEX), UI primitives (Button, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch, Select, Slider, Dialog, AlertDialog, Drawer, Sheet, Label, FormError, Field), generic data patterns (DataTable, StatusChip), and slot-based layout shells (PageShell, Sidebar, HeaderShell). Must never own routing, auth, API calls, or domain business logic. A component may only be added here when consumed by >=2 distinct applications and passes the zero-domain-logic criteria. See .agents/governance/DESIGN_SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE.md for the full contribution policy.

packages/mobile-ui.name: Monorepo React Native UI Primitives
packages/mobile-ui.boundary: Provides React Native UI primitives and styling tokens for mobile applications.

core/src/domains.name: DDD Bounded Contexts
core/src/domains.boundary: Encapsulates core domain business logic, entities, application services, ports, and repository adapters.

shared/src.name: Monorepo Shared Utilities & Constants
shared/src.boundary: Provides domain constants, geofencing helpers, API route path definitions, and headless logic.

backend/api.name: Express HTTP API Server
backend/api.boundary: Exposes HTTP routes, middleware, controllers, and maps HTTP requests to core domain services.

apps/web.name: Next.js User Web Application
apps/web.boundary: User-facing web portal, Next.js App Router pages, user components, and client-side hooks.

apps/admin.name: Next.js Platform Admin Dashboard
apps/admin.boundary: Admin management portal, moderation workflows, user management, system operations UI.

apps/mobile.name: Expo React Native Mobile Application
apps/mobile.boundary: Cross-platform iOS and Android native application built with Expo SDK 52 and React Native.

prohibitedDirectories.core/src/domain: Prohibited. Domain models and value objects belong inside core/src/domains/<context>/domain/.
prohibitedDirectories.shared/src/contracts: Prohibited. DTO contracts belong in @esparex/contracts; route path constants belong in shared/src/routes/.
prohibitedDirectories.core/src/services/notification: Prohibited. Notification services belong in core/src/domains/notifications/.
prohibitedDirectories..agents/workflows: Prohibited. Canonical AI workflows belong in .agents/workflow/.

prohibited: window.scrollTo viewport locks outside the owner

listingPresentation.owner: apps/web/src/lib/listings/listingPresentation.ts + apps/web/src/components/user/ad-card/shared.tsx (overlay badges) distinct from profile/StatusBadge.tsx lifecycle status and CreditPackFormatters credit-pack status
prohibited: global StatusChip merge across badge domains
